facts.fact: Speed Post articles can be tracked through India Post's internet-based Track and Trace system, with delivery information by SMS
facts.quote: Includes Internet-based Track and Trace system & Delivery information on SMS.

facts.fact: On the India Post home page (indiapost.gov.in), enter the consignment (article) number in the tracking box and select Track
facts.quote: Consignment / Money Order Number Initializing CAPTCHA... Track Track Locate Post Office Calculate Postage

behaviour: Points the user to India Post's official online tracking (indiapost.gov.in, enter the Speed Post consignment number) with the link; no unofficial tracking sites.
summary: Added: Speed Post has internet Track and Trace with SMS delivery info (India Post Speed Post page); tracking box on the indiapost.gov.in home page.
